h1: The 5 Best Freestanding Murphy Beds of 2026, Ranked & Reviewed
metaTitle: Best Freestanding Murphy Beds: Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: five Murphy bed cabinets compared on freestanding design, size, storage and anchoring, for renters and walls you cannot drill.
summary: The roomfitters Queen cabinet bed is the best overall pick, pairing an explicit freestanding design with a large rattan storage drawer. The roomfitters Full is the choice for smaller rooms, and the Peanu Queen frame is the plain freestanding option. Treat the Peanu cabinet and LIVAUVEAD as verify-first picks.
intro: The word freestanding gets stretched in Murphy bed listings. A bed that folds into a cabinet is not automatically free of the wall, and many need to be anchored to a stud to stay safe when the mattress swings. If you rent, the anchoring method is the single detail to confirm before ordering.

We reviewed five options from their listings and ranked them on whether freestanding is stated outright, size, storage and finish. Several are brand-new listings with limited history, so each pick carries a note on what to verify with the seller. Hardware-only wall bed kits were left out because they need wall mounting and a cabinet you build yourself.

products.name: roomfitters Queen Size Wood Murphy Cabinet Bed with Rattan Storage Drawer, Free Standing
products.verdict: Freestanding by name, with real storage under the bed.
products.description:
A queen-size wood cabinet bed with a large underbed rattan storage drawer and a white finish. The listing states a free-standing design. It is in the $500 and up bucket.

It takes first place because it combines the freestanding claim with usable storage, which the Peanu frame below does not mention. It is a new listing, so the anchoring method should be confirmed with the seller before ordering.

Choose it if you want a queen sleeping surface in a room where drilling is not an option. Expect a heavy, bulky box to assemble.
products.idealFor: Renters wanting a queen bed and storage without wall mounting.
products.skipIf: You want a long track record first.

products.name: roomfitters Full Size Wood Murphy Cabinet Bed with Rattan Storage Drawer, Free Standing
products.verdict: The same freestanding idea in a smaller full-size build.
products.description:
A full-size freestanding cabinet bed with a large rattan storage drawer, in a green finish. It is priced in the $500 and up bucket.

It ranks second because the full mattress sleeps one person comfortably but a couple less so, which is the only real tradeoff against the queen version above. The smaller footprint is the benefit for studios.

Best for a solo sleeper in a compact room. Confirm the anchor method with the seller, as this is a new listing.
products.idealFor: Solo sleepers in studios or guest rooms.
products.skipIf: Two adults will sleep in it.

products.name: Peanu Queen Bed Frame, Freestanding Murphy Bed, Gray Finish, Wooden Doors
products.verdict: A queen freestanding frame with wooden doors and no wall bracket.
products.description:
A queen-size freestanding frame in a gray finish with wooden doors, and the listing says no wall mount bracket is required. It falls in the $500 and up bucket.

It ranks below the roomfitters pair because storage is not listed, so you get a bed and little else. Against them, its gray finish and door design may suit a living room better.

Pick it for a clean, door-front look in a space where you cannot attach to the wall. Verify the anchor approach before ordering.
products.idealFor: Buyers who want a neat gray front and no wall mounting.

products.name: Peanu Queen Murphy Bed Cabinet, Fold Out Cabinet Bed, Built in Shelf, White
products.verdict: A queen cabinet with a shelf, but the freestanding claim is unclear.
products.description:
A queen-size fold-out cabinet bed with a built-in shelf in white, in the $500 and up bucket. The listing does not state the freestanding claim as clearly as the others do.

It ranks fourth for that reason: the shelf is a nice extra, but freestanding is the whole point of this roundup. The Peanu frame above is explicit about needing no bracket.

Consider it if you like the shelf design and the seller confirms how the unit is secured. Otherwise, choose a pick above.
products.idealFor: Buyers who like a shelf and will confirm anchoring.
products.skipIf: You need a confirmed freestanding bed.

whatMatters.detail: A freestanding Murphy bed stands on its own base instead of bolting to wall studs. It matters for renters and plaster walls. Look for the words no wall mount required or free standing in the title, and ask the seller about any tip-over anchors.

A full mattress is about 54 inches wide, while a queen is about 60 inches. The extra six inches decides whether a couple fits comfortably. Check the listed size and measure the room, including the open-bed depth.
An underbed drawer or shelf turns the cabinet into more than a bed. It matters in a small room where floor space is scarce. Look for named storage features and their size in the listing.
Cabinet beds are heavy and arrive in multiple boxes. You may need two people and several hours. Check the listed shipping weight and assembly notes before ordering.
New listings have fewer owner reports to learn from. That is not a flaw by itself, but it raises the cost of a bad surprise. Message the seller about anchors and returns before buying.

faq.q: Is a freestanding Murphy bed safe without wall anchors?
faq.a: Some designs rely on weight and a wide base, but you should still ask the seller about tip-over anchors. Do not assume a freestanding label means no anchoring is ever advised.

faq.q: What is the biggest mistake buyers make?
faq.a: Skipping the room measurements. Check the open-bed depth and ceiling height, not just the closed cabinet size.

faq.q: Is queen worth it over full?
faq.a: For two sleepers yes, since the queen is about six inches wider. One person in a small room can use the roomfitters Full and save floor space.
Expect heavy boxes and a few hours with two people. Read the listing for tools included.

faq.q: Do I need a special mattress?
faq.a: Many Murphy beds need a mattress of limited thickness so the cabinet closes. Check the stated maximum thickness before choosing a mattress.

faq.q: Why are wall-mount kits left out?
faq.a: Hardware kits require wall mounting and a cabinet you build. They do not match a search for a freestanding bed.

finalTake: The roomfitters Queen cabinet bed is the best freestanding pick, with stated freestanding design and real storage. Choose the roomfitters Full for a smaller room or the Peanu frame for a gray, door-front look. Treat the Peanu cabinet and LIVAUVEAD as verify-first options. In every case, confirm the anchoring method before ordering.
